Apify.tutorialTitle: How to get an Apify API token
Apify.tutorialIntro: Follow these steps once. The token lets Bizcraw run Actors and read their results in your Apify account.
Apify.tutorialAccountTitle: Create or sign in to an Apify account.
Apify.tutorialAccountBody: If you are new to Apify, register with email, Google, or GitHub:
Apify.tutorialVerifyBody: When signing up with email, open Apify's verification email and confirm your address.
Apify.tutorialSettingsBody: In Apify Console, go to Settings → API & Integrations, or use this shortcut:
Apify.tutorialCreateBody: Choose Create new token, name it “Bizcraw”, and allow Actor runs plus access to the datasets and storage created by those runs.
Apify.tutorialCopyBody: Copy the complete token when Apify shows it. Do not add spaces or quotation marks.
Apify.tutorialConnectBody: Paste the token below, keep the token name as Bizcraw, then select Verify and connect. Your Apify account, plan, and usage will appear after verification.
Apify.tutorialSecurity: Treat this token like a password. Use a separate token for Bizcraw, never send it by email or chat, and rotate it in Apify if it is exposed.
